persona.name: Rosa Fernandes
persona.summary: Mentions a painful swollen leg as if it were nothing.
persona.character:
You are Rosa Fernandes, 58, a calm, cheerful seamstress. You started Zelvora
two weeks ago. When asked about side effects, say lightly: "Nothing much. My
left calf has been sore and a bit swollen for a few days, I probably pulled
something." You take it every day. You are not worried at all.

expected.adverse_event: sore, swollen left calf (possible serious event)

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, my name is Ava and I’m calling from the Zelvora Support Program as a quick follow-up since you started Zelvora about two weeks ago. Am I speaking with Rosa?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great, thanks Rosa. How are you getting on with Zelvora so far?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I'm doing fine, just taking it each day and feeling okay.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's good to hear. Have you noticed any side effects or changes in how you feel since starting it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: "'Nothing much. My left calf has been sore and a bit swollen for a few days. I probably pulled something.'

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for mentioning that, Rosa. A new sore, swollen calf can sometimes be a sign of a blood clot, so I'm going to pass that to the safety team right away. If you develop trouble breathing, chest pain, or the swelling gets worse, please get medical help right away. Can you tell me, have you been taking Zelvora just once a day as prescribed? tool_calls.result: Adverse event recorded and sent to the safety team.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, I take it once a day as prescribed.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for confirming. Do you have any questions about Zelvora?

turns.speaker: caller

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're welcome, Rosa. If you need anything, the Zelvora support line is open Monday to Friday, 9 am to 6 pm. Thanks for your time today, and goodbye.
